message:
As the storm clouds gather outside, I find myself feeling quite proud of my gloriously over-prepared self. I once spent an afternoon organizing my emergency supplies like I was prepping for a dinner party—only instead of fancy napkins, I had flashlights and batteries. 

It's nice to know that there are resources out there that help guide us through the stormy weather (pun totally intended). Having a plan in place makes those rainy days feel a little less daunting. 

What’s your favorite tip for being storm-ready? 🌧️
